_note: Portraits resolve from reference/data/_avatars_index.json, which is also where rank and element come from — so nothing here is read off a screenshot. Cast rotates on the 1st of the month; re-check then.
_rule: Open with the weakest viable four. Characters spend Vigor, so the same four cannot carry a run — and the three 4-stars already cover all three elements between them.

act1.blessing: Electro-Charged is at Blessing Lv. 1. The other two reactions are at Lv. 0.

cast.name: Aino
cast.why: Your Hydro for Electro-Charged, and she is a 4-star — exactly the kind of unit you want spending Vigor early.

cast.name: Fischl
cast.why: Oz applies Electro without you touching her. You also own Fischl, which is why she is worth knowing by face.

cast.name: Kachina
cast.why: Covers Geo so the team has all three season elements. The only Geo you can field cheaply.

cast.name: Flins
cast.why: The one 5-star worth spending on Act 1 — Electro-Charged is the reaction at Blessing Lv. 1, and 80 seconds asks for damage rather than defence.

cast.name: Zhongli
cast.why: Keep at full Vigor. A shield is worth most where damage actually threatens, which is not Act 1.

cast.name: Yelan
cast.why: The strongest applier in the cast. Save her for Act 10's Radiant Moonfly, which resists both of its own elements.

benchNote: These two are your Alternate Cast. They are NOT playable yet — they only join the Principal Cast when you draft one after winning a Battle. You have no Geo on the bench at all, so take a Geo draft almost regardless of who it is.
